renmods: Download and query data from B.C. Environmental Monitoring Data System (EnMoDs)

Source: R/renmods-package.R
renmods-package.Rd

Downloads and queries data from B.C. Environmental Monitoring Data System (EnMoDs).

Package options

The following options control package behavior:

renmods.cache_dir

Directory for caching downloaded data. Default: NULL (uses tools::R_user_dir("renmods", "cache")). Set to a custom path to override default location.

renmods.urls

Named list of URLs for EnMoDS data sources. Contains: this_yr, yr_2_5, yr_5_10, and historic. URLs are provided by default but can be overridden.

Set options using options(), for example:


options(renmods.cache_dir = "~/.renmods_cache")

Datasets

The package provides access to four EnMoDS datasets covering different time periods:

this_yr

Current year data (updates weekly)

yr_2_5

Data from 2-5 years ago (updates every 26 weeks)

yr_5_10

Data from 5-10 years ago (updates every 26 weeks)

historic

Data older than 10 years (updates every 26 weeks)
